## Summary / 改动摘要

## Evidence / 事实依据

- Paper IDs, original sources and publication/version relationships:
- Added / updated / merged counts:
- Reading scope and concrete selection reasons for new papers:

## Checks / 检查

- [ ] Existing IDs, optional fields, provenance and rejected-link history preserved.
- [ ] No preprint/final-version duplicates; classification based on actual modalities.
- [ ] Unknown facts remain unknown; summaries and secondary sources are labelled.
- [ ] `npm run validate`, `npm test`, build and relevant browser tests passed.
- [ ] README / CHANGELOG updated when relevant.
- [ ] No secrets, private notes, machine paths, generated output or third-party PDFs committed.
